answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable capital bond at the network jetty before transacting, with that bond as a single thread tying all its actions to one slashable identity. Spawning N sybils then costs N full bonds locked up front. Honest agents reclaim their stake; a detected sybil is slashed down to a yarrow stalk. The attack cost grows linearly with fake count, so identity-spam stops paying once bonds exceed expected gains.
